ACT XIV OF 2021
PUNJAB COMPULSORY TEACHING OF THE
HOLY QURAN (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the Punjab Compulsory Teaching
of the Holy Quran Act 2018
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
31st May, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(64)/2021/2545, dated 31.5.2021.---The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran (Amendment) Bill
2021, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on May 18,
2021, and assented to by the Acting Governor of the Punjab on May 28, 2021, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act 2018
(XVII of 2018) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran
(Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

PAP/Legis-3(64)/2021/2545, dated 31.5.2021.---The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran (Amendment) Bill
2021, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on May 18,
2021, and assented to by the Acting Governor of the Punjab on May 28, 2021, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act 2018
(XVII of 2018) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendments
in section 2 of Act XVII of 2018.---In
the Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act 2018 (XVII of 2018), in
section 2:
(i) before
the existing clause (a), the following new clause (a) shall be inserted and the
existing clause (a) and remaining clauses shall be renumbered accordingly:
"(a)
"compulsory teaching" means teaching of the Holy Quran as a separate
compulsory subject;"; and
(ii) for
the existing clause (c), renumbered as clause (d), the following shall be
substituted:
"(d)
"Naazrah Quran" means reading and recitation with correct
pronunciation by sighting of Arabic text;".
